messages:
mira: heads-up: onboarding canary for lotus-compact-int8 showed a reproducible multilocale regression. Summary: BLEU -1.9, chrF -2.4, token count +3.8%. Hits concentrated in zh/ja and intermittent RTL bracket reordering.
jon: ouch. any small repros we can paste here? helps isolate tokenizer vs logits.
kei: dropping two tiny repros from the failing bucket. baseline=lotus-fp16, candidate=lotus-int8-q5a:
```
# zh sample
INPUT: "请把最新的会议记录(第3页)发给我。"
BASELINE: same
CANDIDATE: "请把最新的会议记录 ​(第3页)发给我。"  # U+200B inserted before paren

# hebrew sample (rtl bracket)
INPUT: "הוא (דחוף) לבדוק."
BASELINE: same
CANDIDATE: "הוא )דחוף( לבדוק."  # parentheses mirrored in detok
```
mira: token dump for zh sample: baseline token ids -> [4501,210,9999], candidate -> [4501,210,77777,9999] where 77777 maps to U+200B.
alan: infra: this canary used quant profile q5a (per-tensor asymmetric) + fused-attn-kernel-v2 + runtime detok micro-opt enabled. multiple changes landed together.
sumi: given the inserted invisible codepoint, my hunch is detok micro-opt touched the post-processing normalization (maybe adding directional isolates or incorrectly preserving presentation forms). but quant could perturb logits at boundaries and make an alternative token selected. need to bisect.
jon: plan: 1) run int8 weights with legacy detok path (opt-out) 2) run candidate with symmetric->asymmetric quant switching 3) bisect commit range to isolate detok change vs kernel reorders.
platform-i18n: please tag us on the reproducer issue. we'll check unicode normalization (NFKC/NFC differences), bidi isolate handling, and any ZWSP/ZWNBSP policy we enforce.
canary-bot: canary snapshot: 900 samples, 35 zh/ja invisible-codepoint insertions, 6 rtl bracket diffs, delta BLEU -1.87, delta chrF -2.35. artifacts: s3://canary/lotus/3512346789/report.json
kei: short-term mitigation: opt-out detok micro-opt for lotus package in canary config and re-run. add unit test in tokenizer-regress to assert no inserted ZWSP/U+200B, U+200A, U+202F around punctuation/ruby marks.
mira: long-term: add a char-span -> token-span diff gate to onboarding smoke. if token delta > 1.5% for locale X fail onboarding. also add visual bidi orientation regression check for RTL samples (ensure bracket visual order consistent with baseline).
alan: i'll schedule rollback window if opt-out shows regression improvement. also expose token-boundary diffs in canary UI for faster triage.
jon: i'll start the bisect and post updates. thanks for quick triage everyone.
mira: opening issue with repro snippet, token dumps, and canary S3 link; tagging platform-i18n. ping me to triage live. :thumbsup:
